about: Derived palette counts from the owner’s 12 November 2026 dash cam catalogue. One resolved game-building match per sample; houses include cottages and mobile homes, farm buildings include sheds and garages. Unknown and mixed colours are excluded. Only spelling aliases are normalized. A group with no known roof materials uses the pooled house and farm roof-material counts from this area. These are area distributions, not per-building paint matches. Existing step 30 detail rates remain estimates.
